meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 把旧的“一个机器人包办所有 Slack”改为每个 Agent 组各有专属机器人，保留身份、工作区、记忆和原有连接方式；迁移由你逐步确认、可暂停续传，也可以选择保留经典模式并记录决定。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示需要 Slack agents 时，或在之后任何时候你单独提出迁移需求时触发。

say.text: 把我的 Slack 迁移成每个 Agent 组一个专属机器人。
say.note: 会先检查经典模式并列出迁移计划等你确认。
手动启动同一条迁移流程。

say.text: 保留当前的经典 Slack 设置，不迁移。
say.note: 记录选择，不改变任何现有配置。

howto.what_en: Migrates classic single-bot Slack to one Slack app per agent group, preserving identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring. Operator-guided and resumable. Optionally records a stay-on-classic decision. Never creates agent groups.
howto.when_en: When /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone at any later time the operator requests the migration.

say_en.text: Migrate my Slack to one dedicated bot per Agent group.
say_en.note: Checks for classic mode and shows a migration plan first.
Starts the same guided migration manually.

say_en.text: Keep the current classic Slack setup and do not migrate.
say_en.note: Records the choice; no configuration changes are made.
